subject: Android device certificate keeps failing to install
description: User reports SCEP certificate deployment failing repeatedly on their Samsung Galaxy Tab. Wi-Fi and VPN profiles that depend on the cert are also not applying.

subject: Laptop keeps dropping off corporate Wi-Fi
description: User's Windows laptop connects to corporate Wi-Fi then drops after a few minutes. Started after last week's profile update.

subject: Device shows non-compliant despite meeting requirements
description: Device passed BitLocker and antivirus checks locally but Intune still reports non-compliant, blocking Conditional Access.

subject: New laptop stuck on Autopilot enrollment screen
description: Freshly imaged laptop stuck at 'Preparing your device' for over an hour during Autopilot enrollment.

subject: Unusual: device reports two conflicting compliance policies
description: Device is a member of two dynamic groups with contradictory compliance policies applied; unclear which is authoritative. Not seen before.
